title: SunSpec Explorer snapshot export
description: One read of a SunSpec device, as exported by the OT Fabric SunSpec Explorer (schema identifier otfabric.sunspec-explorer.snapshot/1). All timestamps are UTC, RFC 3339. All register addresses are zero-based Modbus addresses.

captured_at.description: Start of the first request. Models are read one after another: a snapshot is not an atomic view of the device.

metadata.description: full: points carry label, description, access, mandatory and static. compact: they do not.

device.description: Identification from the Common model, or null when the device has none or it could not be read.

AppInfo.description: The application that wrote the file.

LibInfo.description: The libraries that decoded the data.

go_sunspec.description: Version of the go-sunspec library that decoded the data.

registry_models.description: Number of SunSpec model schemas the library knows.

url.description: tcp://host:port, rtuovertcp://host:port, tcp+tls://host:port or rtu://<device>; never with credentials.

DeviceIdentity.description: Identification points of the Common model (model 1).

ModelResult.description: The outcome of reading one model instance.

index.description: Position in the model chain. A device can hold several models with the same id.

start_address.description: Address of the model's ID register.

length.description: Number of data registers after the ID and length registers.

status.description: changed: the device no longer holds this model at this address.

error.description: Why the read failed; null when status is ok.

stale.description: While polling: the last good read of the model is older than two poll intervals.

last_ok_at.description: Time of the last good read of the model in this session; omitted when there was none.

group.description: The decoded model, or null when it was not decoded (no schema, or the read failed).

raw_registers.description: Data registers of a model without schema, or of every model when the request asked for them; otherwise null.

GroupView.description: One decoded group instance: its points and the group instances nested in it.

index.description: 1-based instance number within the parent; 0 for the top-level group.

type.description: SunSpec point type, for example int16, acc32, enum16, sunssf, string.

implemented.description: false: the device reports the SunSpec not-implemented value; raw then holds that sentinel, not a measurement.

raw.description: Unscaled value: a number, a string, a list of registers for a type that is not decoded, or null for a float that is not a number.

scaled.description: raw times 10^sf_raw, or null without a resolved scale factor.

sf_name.description: Name of the scale factor point.

sf_raw.description: Value of the scale factor point.

symbols.description: Names of the active enum value or bitfield flags.

address.description: Absolute address of the point's first register.

offset.description: Register offset from the model's ID register.
